# P29.1 — Contributor identity + corrections/contribution ops (ACTIVATE.1, Round 7)

Implements `docs/tickets/P29.1__contributor-identity-and-ops.md`. Turns on the human
loop under **identity minimization** (ADR-100 §3): the least identity each contribution
type needs, and **no homegrown account/credential system**. Stacked on
`devin/p28-6-accountability-linkage`.

## Summary

- **Productionizes the tier-token curator store** — replaces the demo `CURATION_KEYS`
  map with a real **issue/invite-based**, pseudonymous, env-provisioned store (NOT open
  signup).
- **Wires the anonymous `/dispute` intake to append-only correction claims** + adds a
  takedown/corrections operator runbook (§36/§45 governance).
- **Wires OSM contribution-back activation-ready** (a concrete httpx MapRoulette
  transport in the CLI) per HG-08 = ACTIVATE NOW — with the honesty rules the gate set.

## Design decisions

- **No SIG-owned accounts.** Only three identity tiers (ADR-100): anonymous `/dispute`,
  OSM-mediated contribution-back, and invite/env-provisioned pseudonymous curators. A
  token works only when its handle is **both** invited (committed) **and** provisioned
  (operator env) — "invite-based, not open signup" + "secrets env-only" in one mechanism.
- **Activation-ready, never fabricated.** The transport makes a live push possible, but
  the registration gate (exit 3) + dry-run posture keep it dormant until HG-08 is armed.
